_note: ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS for gameplay.

mass.title: Puzzle 1: Mass
mass.intro: The rocket slot can lift 4.0 kg. Load the parts for a photo mission without going over.
mass.lesson: Every part has mass, and the rocket has a hard limit.

needs.missing: You need a camera to take photos.
You need solar panels for power.
You need a battery for the dark part of the orbit.
You need a radio to send the photos down.

power.title: Puzzle 2: Power
power.intro: The Earth blocks the Sun for part of every orbit. Size the panels and battery so the satellite survives.
power.lesson: Panels must make enough power on average, and the battery must cover the eclipse.

link.title: Puzzle 3: Data link
link.intro: The camera makes more photos than the radio can send. Fix it with the mass and money you have left.
link.lesson: Data only counts when it reaches the ground. The slowest step sets the pace.

time.title: Puzzle 4: Budget and time
time.intro: Get everything ready for the launch on day 180 without overspending.
time.lesson: Paperwork takes months. Start it early, because waiting costs money every day.
